I'll start by reading TASK.md and brief.md so I can follow the brief exactly.Section 0 points at the T9 brief, decision, and both reviews. I'll read those next, then the starting-point files.T9 closed partial: the frame is driven by `0x88b2`, but the store that fills the paint coordinates and the invalidation path were not found. I'll read the prior runners, listings, and inherited rules before any emulator session.The paint site reloads stack slots that were spilled from registers, so the coordinate object is upstream of `0x610eedee`. I'll disassemble the setter and scan callers before any emulator session.The setter queues a type-1 change record and the paint function reads a widget at a fixed offset. I'll trace one setter call to catch that object and the store that fills the paint coordinates.The broad probe scan would slow the whole session. I'll keep probes on the known setter and paint instructions, then disassemble the rest of the post helper before the run.Version 1 opened a session and stopped on a bad png import. The next script keeps that run unchanged and uses the emulator's png module.The setter ran at the image address, and the marks move during the idle after it returns. The probes were on the flash-view addresses, so they never saw that code.The cell is read through a halfword load during the refresh. The last run will name that load's caller and check whether an AF-ON press reaches it.The pixel-field writer is still not named, so the last run stays observation only. Next I’ll check the overlay sections and write the result.The AF corner marks follow the live halfword of key `0x88b2`, and the pixel-field writer that turns that value into the on-screen rectangle was not identified. No display change was installed.

On stock K1, with `(0x8050)` clear, setter `0x60063431` stores the halfword directly at `0x60063534` into `0x629526c0` and sets the dirty byte at `0x6006355e`. The marks are still at (417, 265) 66×70 when that call returns. After 500 ms they are at (356, 198) 65×71. During that idle the only read of the cell is the halfword load at `0x60063a5e`, reached through getter `0x60063380`. The reload at `0x610eedee` runs in the same idle with coordinates (123, 554) and (4, 110), not 356 and 198.

An AF-ON press on seeded T6 and on unseeded T6 sets the owner to 2 and publishes the ten-byte target (position 529 seeded, 532 unseeded). The cell stays 526 and the corner-mark union stays (417, 265). The refresh flag writer `0x610f7172` does run. Subject Detect `0x1e71[0]` stayed 0. The T6 overlay’s 3262 rows are sections 1, 2, 4 and 7 only, and the only section-7 bytes are `0x610bf5e3`–`0x610bf5e5`.

Six emulator processes were used. `work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place, with the seal in `work/out/manifest-seal-t9b.json` and the external finalizer in `work/out/manifest-final-t9b.json`.
